protocols.qntDuty: Finite interleavings: deduplicate discovery, no publication before complete census and acknowledgements, one decision observed by all three participants before flip or refused return, no refused/unknown flip, no early return
protocols.leanDuty: Existing ProducerCapacity, RoundCapacity and CopyCapacityComposition prove parametric source envelopes, interval coverage and conservation under explicit premises; they do not repeat participant schedules
protocols.premise: One shared-memory VM round, three objects and three participants, two finite regions. No cross-machine protocol, unbounded-member theorem or liveness claim. Finite placement guards abstract valid C intervals. Source inventory completeness, packing arithmetic, physical exclusion, every real participant and failure custody need a separate C/data adapter

protocols.qntDuty: Finite interleavings of root registration before collecting conversion, writer drain before frozen scan, pre-marker GC and reload, nested activation, closed-entry refusal and known-exit release. closing is a close request, not proof that an already admitted writer stopped
protocols.leanDuty: Existing HostRootsRefinement owns stable-cell to root-view mapping and relocation premises. New root_count span coverage needs source refinement; no duplicate writer state machine or fresh Lean completion claimed
protocols.premise: One shared-memory root domain, callback depth at most two, two conversion/store observations. No liveness or cross-machine claim. C gate sections are noncollecting stores. A conversion may collect only with inputs in registered stable cells; the model does not hold a writer permit throughout an allocating converter. Correct span initialization, PSTATE/context identity, no raw aliases and native stop remain C premises
